name: Scatterhand Step
description: Take a step with the scatterhand school's loose hips so the body never lands where it seemed to aim.

name: Askance Strike
description: Strike while looking away from the target so no tell shows in the eyes or the shoulders.

name: Flustered Guard
description: Flutter both hands in front of the body in a flustered guard that glances blows aside.

name: Wrangle Touch
description: Wrangle the foe's wrist in a twisting grip that spins the arm one way and then the other.

name: Haywire Jab
description: Jab with a fist that goes haywire in the last pace and crosses the foe's own qi flow.

name: Motley Burst
description: Burst a motley of different forces from the palms that strike near foes in different ways.

name: Derange Hand
description: Lay a hand on the foe and derange the pattern of their senses until left looks like right.

name: Overturn Blow
description: Throw a blow from below that overturns the foe's stance and sends them sprawling.

name: Thousand Askance
description: Loose a thousand glancing blows from every side in no order that overwhelm any guard set against one.

name: Scattered Crown
description: The school's crowning move that scatters the user's strikes across the foe's whole frame with an effect that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Syncopated Stance
description: Shift the stance on off-beats so that no timing of strike falls on a settled guard.

name: Skewed Parry
description: Parry on a skewed beat just before or just after the blow lands.

name: Uneven Tread
description: Tread in a limping uneven measure that the foe mistakes for weakness.

name: Rhythm Thief
description: Steal the beat of the foe's attack and hand it back out of time.

name: Timing Snare
description: Draw the foe into a blow timed to a beat that never comes.

name: Beatless Ward
description: Hold a wall of qi that pulses with no pattern and so cannot be struck in its lull.

name: Counter Stutter
description: Stutter once against a blow and let the recoil carry a counter into the foe's side.

name: Arrhythmic Guard
description: Hold a guard with no rhythm that breaks the timing of every blow that touches it.

name: Dissonant Return
description: Return the force of a struck blow out of time so it lands on the attacker as a jarring shock.

name: Unbeaten Measure
description: Hold a measure that has no beat and cancels the force of every timed technique cast at the user.

name: Guard Without Beat
description: The school's defining guard which turns every timed attack to nothing with a strength that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Azure Jumble
description: Pulse a jumble of azure qi outward that tangles the field close to the user.

name: Daft Step
description: Take a daft step that looks like a stumble and ends inside the foe's guard.

name: Zigzag Palm
description: Whip a palm in a zigzag that no guard follows to its end.

name: Muddled Qi
description: Muddle the qi of the field about the body so that attacks lose their line within it.

name: Disorder Seed
description: Plant a seed of disorder in the foe's qi that grows with each technique they cast.

name: Skybreak Pulse
description: Pulse shocks of chaos upward and let them fall in showers of uneven force.

name: Warped Horizon
description: Warp the apparent horizon of the field so foes mistake near for far and up for down.

name: Seed Bloom
description: Bloom every seed of disorder at once so the foes carrying them jolt and lose hold of their moves.

name: Governed Chaos
description: Rule the disorder of the field so that it falls only on foes and spares the user and allies.

name: Cloudburst Havoc
description: Break the sky field open in a downpour of wild force that falls with no two drops alike.

name: Azure Upheaval
description: Turn the whole field upside down in an upheaval that throws every foe and every pattern into ruin.

name: Ordered Disorder
description: The school's central move which lays a measured disorder across the field with a reach and weight that scale with the user's reserve.

name: Core Flicker
description: Flicker the weight of the body about the formed core and arrive off the line of attack.

name: Coronal Fist
description: Strike with a fist that bears a thin crown of wild force at the knuckles.

name: Spinning Shell
description: Spin a shell of chaos qi about the core that turns blows in all directions.

name: Chaos Anchor
description: Anchor the foe's qi with a knot of disorder so they cannot shift position or form.

name: Sovereign Jolt
description: Jolt the core of a foe with a regal disorder that throws their qi flow out of true.

name: Crown Spiral
description: Spiral chaos outward from the core in a crown of force that strikes everything near.

name: Regent Storm
description: Rule a storm of chaos from the core as a regent rules a realm and aim it at chosen foes.

name: Sapphire Sundering
description: Drive sapphire chaos qi through guard and shield in a thin spear that sunders both.

name: Flux Dominion
description: Hold a dominion of constant flux in which no fixed technique of any foe may stand.

name: Chaos Crown
description: The apex move of the line that sets a sovereign crown of chaos over the field and grows with the user's core.

name: Oathpost Step
description: Pivot on a sworn post of qi at the heel and throw the body wide of the blow.

name: Anchored Fist
description: Strike with a fist anchored in the oath while the rest of the body moves without plan.

name: Postbound Guard
description: Hold one fixed point in the guard and let all about it shift and swirl against the blow.

name: Discord Thrower
description: Throw a ball of discord from the sworn post and watch it burst in the foe's stance.

name: Voice Crack
description: Crack the voice of the oath into a harsh note that rattles the foe's concentration.

name: Gale Warp
description: Warp the nearby wind into crosswise gusts that knock foes about the sworn post.

name: Pivot Tangle
description: Tangle the foe in lines drawn from the sworn post until all their movement draws toward it.

name: Sworn Chaos
description: Throw all the discord stored in the oath outward at once in a ring of broken force.

name: Oathbreaker Wave
description: Send a wave that breaks every other oath and fixed stance while the user's own remains.

name: Discord Ascendant
description: Raise the sworn discord to its height and hurl it across the whole front in one heaving blow.

name: Oath of Discord
description: The school's closing move in which the sworn oath is turned loose as discord with force that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Wavering Feint
description: Let the line of the body waver on purpose so the foe's blow goes where the user is not.

name: Falter Strike
description: Falter in the middle of an advance then strike hard into the opening the foe leaps for.

name: Sidling Step
description: Sidle off the line in short crabbed steps that wear away the foe's aim.

name: Tilting Stance
description: Tilt the whole stance back and forth so the guard is never where it was.

name: False Gap
description: Open a false gap in the guard that draws the foe's blow onto a prepared counter.

name: Crooked Thrust
description: Thrust along a crooked path that bends round the guard before it reaches the target.

name: Waver Wave
description: Send a wavering pulse along the line that jostles every foe in it in turn.

name: Reeling Snare
description: Reel in the advancing foe with a snare of wavering qi that tightens at each step.

name: Staggering Advance
description: Advance in a stagger that breaks the foe's line apart at every pace of the approach.

name: Knotting Pulse
description: Undo the order of the advancing line with a pulse that leaves it in knots.

name: Order Toppled
description: Collapse the entire order of the foe's ranks in a single heave of disorder.

name: Deliberate Waver
description: The school's central move in which a deliberate waver draws the foe on and breaks them with force that grows with the user's reserve.

name: Anarchist Step
description: Step by no law of the school and no rule of the wind across the field.

name: Ungoverned Palm
description: Strike with a palm that no hand governs and the wind does not carry.

name: Free Guard
description: Let the guard float free of the body and take the blow wherever it falls.

name: Lawbreaker Touch
description: Touch a bound technique and break the law that holds its form.

name: Unruled Gust
description: Hurl a gust that obeys no school or wind law and tears at the guard.

name: Anarchic Surge
description: Surge across the field with qi that follows no order and breaks every rank before it.

name: Walk Unbound
description: Walk through the field unbound so that no law of control or binding takes hold on the body.

name: Rule Shatterer
description: Smash a blow into the structure of an enemy technique and break the law that built it.

name: Lawless Gale
description: Loose a gale that obeys no law and leaves no pattern standing across the whole field.

name: Anarchy Sovereign
description: The school's defining move that makes the user sovereign over unruled wind and breaks every foe's order with force that grows with reserve.

name: Eyewall Calm
description: Keep a calm point at the centre of the body while wild force turns around it.

name: Turned Fist
description: Throw a fist wrapped in the tempest's turning so it lands as a heavy spinning blow.

name: Still Footing
description: Keep the feet still on the core's oath while the torso sways in the storm.

name: Stillpoint Strike
description: Strike from the calm centre of the tempest with no motion wasted and all the storm behind it.

name: Wheeling Chaos
description: Wheel a ring of chaos outward from the still centre and sweep the near ground.

name: Core Oath
description: Swear the core to calm and let that oath press down on any wild force that nears.

name: Storm Cage
description: Raise a cage of whirling force about the foe with the user at the calm point beyond it.

name: Eyewall Fury
description: Throw the full fury of the eyewall outward in a ring that shreds everything in its path.

name: Anchored Vortex
description: Hold a vortex of chaos anchored to the core and draw foes into it one by one.

name: Storm Regent
description: Command the whole tempest of chaos from the calm core and bring it down on a chosen front.

name: Oath Beneath Tempest
description: The apex move of the line in which the core's calm oath governs a tempest whose scale grows with the user's core.
